duration: One-day conference at NC State (the 2026 listing gives April 16 and 17, 2026)
name: North Carolina Youth Institute
org: NC State Cooperative Extension with World Food Prize Foundation
what_you_do: Research a global issue and write a 3 to 4 page paper with a teacher or mentor. Then present at a one-day conference at NC State. Top students may represent North Carolina at the Global Youth Institute in Des Moines, Iowa.
who_can_apply: Must be a high school student. The page does not list grade rules or a residency requirement.
deadline_text: 2026 conference was April 16-17, 2026 with an early March 2026 registration deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Visit the program website to learn more and sign up (growforit.ces.ncsu.edu/growforit-programs/nc-youth-institute). The page does not tell how to sign up.
